collection.credit:
ISOLA — BEYOND THE HORIZON: THE WORLD WE IMAGINE
A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5
Version 1.0 | 40 original branching events
collection.description: A child assumes life beyond Isola must be an endless adventure. A tired farmer doubts it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A child assumes life beyond Isola must be an endless adventure. A tired farmer doubts it.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: They invent a distant worker who misplaces a tool, eats lunch, and comes home tired; the child is disappointed and amused.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The farmer wonders whether some people work at night or indoors; the group considers how many routines are possible.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The children invent festivals, games, books, and quiet afternoons for people they will never meet.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A caregiver asks who does the necessary work while others rest; the conversation becomes a debate about fairness.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A villager says that a peaceful uneventful day can be a gift after hardship.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Another admits that sameness can feel stifling; both perspectives are allowed to stand.
